name: Wi-Fi Signal Strength Positioning Benchmark
description: Provides benchmark measurements of Wi‑Fi signal strengths for evaluating indoor positioning/localization algorithms.
reputation: A well-cited, domain-specific indoor Wi‑Fi fingerprinting dataset used in indoor positioning research though not a broadly used community-wide benchmark.
notes: Non‑LLM benchmark; results are environment- and AP-specific (limited transferability). Dataset size and AP coverage may be small; performance susceptible to sensor/environmental drift and dataset saturation.
